description: Still water on a gently sloping beach (S 61 wedge, 1:8.6, direct forcing), the free surface through the wedge: the level set inside the solid extrapolated linearly from the fluid (X 48 2, the default), the still water level a plane through the bed, no flow along the shore line (umax 3e-4 m/s after 100 steps; held constant along the normal of the solid instead, the free surface bends at the shore line and drives 0.75 m/s). The solid level set inside the wedge is no distance: the layers of the extrapolation from its sign alone.
covers: levelset_solid_extend: the linear extrapolation, the layers inside a solid without a distance (S 61), the domain edges left out
